messages:
emma: Heads up 5: noticed an ATS export regression: accommodation flags are missing from CSV exports this morning. Interviewer kits for two candidates didn't show "requires_live_caption" so scheduling stalled. cc @sam @jules
sam: Oof. Which part of the pipeline? export, mapping lambda, or the kit renderer?
emma: Quick dig: raw ATS webhook has the flags, mapping lambda output (CSV) has the header but blank values. Example old CSV row:
```
candidate_id,full_name,accessibility_flags
78901,Casey Li,requires_live_caption;deaf
```
New CSV:
```
candidate_id,full_name,accessibility_flags
78901,Casey Li,
```
jules: That sounds like the refactor that flattened metadata arrays. I'll triage. Can someone paste the webhook JSON?
emma: Redacted payload: {"id":"78901","name":"Casey Li","meta":{"accessibility":[{"type":"live_caption","value":true}]}}
alina: If mapping strips arrays, interviewer_kits and scorecards that reference accessibility will break. We should assume both are impacted.
sam: Priorities: 1) short-term backfill for scheduled/interviewing candidates, 2) patch mapping lambda + unit tests, 3) add alert + e2e check, 4) update interviewer training checklist.
jules: I'll write a backfill script that reads raw webhooks and populates interviewer_kits.accessibility_flags and scorecard_meta.accessibility. Kicking off now. Will run in batches and post progress.
emma: Thank you. For training, can we add a one-liner in the interviewer onboarding doc: "Check accommodations field in kit before confirming time" and a screenshot of where it appears? That will reduce scheduling friction while we fix infra.
alina: I'll update the interviewer playbook and post to #new-interviewers. Also adding a quick note in the calendar invite template: "If accommodations missing, contact recruiting ops."
infra-bot: job backfill_accommodations started by jules 5 id bf-20260321-07
jules: Batch 1 done (500 candidates). Found 12 flagged candidates missing flags in kits; updated records. No failures. Continuing.
emma: Can we also add a readonly "Accommodations" field to scorecard UI so raters see it during interviews? Low risk and helps awareness.
sam: Good idea. Make it read-only and part of the header so reviewers don't miss it.
jules: I'll include the UI field in the mapper migration so new and backfilled records both get it. Will add unit tests for array->semicolon join and regression tests in the export e2e.
emma: Once backfill completes, let's run a spot audit on 200 flagged candidates and confirm kits+scorecards surface flags. If green, we file a short postmortem with timeline, root cause (mapping refactor dropped arrays), mitigation, and follow-ups.
jules: Backfill progress: 1500/6000 processed, 0 errors. Posting logs to the infra cluster logs link.
infra-bot: job bf-20260321-07 status: 1500/6000 processed, 0 errors
sam: After patch/merge, add an alert if export CSV has any empty accessibility_flags for candidates where source webhook included accessibility. Also add a daily backfill-run for next 48h as a safety net.
alina: I'll handle the training comms and add the checklist screenshot.
emma: Thanks all. Please @me if anything blocks the backfill or mapping PR. :white_check_mark:
